notes: Bando: in and out of windows, up the lift shaft, under the water tank, through the loading dock. The bando's frame (first-map.ts bando): x -280 to -220, z -12 to 12, storeys 3.6 m; a window is 2.5 m wide, 1 to 2.8 m over its floor. Which wall bays are windows is the map's own Rng(2): south face, first floor, bay x -244 to -238; north face, first floor, bay x -256 to -250, and ground floor, bay x -232 to -226 (checked in the test). The shaft is bay x -232 to -226, z -6 to 0, open through every floor and the roof (its beams on the column lines). The tank stands on legs at x -236.5 and -233.5, z 4.5 and 7.5, its body from 22 m; the dunnage beams under the legs reach 18.4 m. The loading dock annex: x -274 to -256, z 12 to 22, its dock 1.2 m up, roof from 7 m, posts on its south side at x -274, -268, -262, -256; open to the east.
